description: Source code for managing RAM retention and CRC validation on nRF52 microcontroller in Zephyr OS, including functions for setting retention, validating retained data, and updating uptime metrics.

methods.name: retained_validate
methods.description: Validates the integrity of retained data using CRC32 checksum, resets data if invalid, and reconfigures retention settings.

methods.name: retained_update
methods.description: Updates uptime metrics in retained data and recalculates CRC32 checksum.
